obligations.title: Permutation matrix of budget vs selection bounds, prior work, siblings, exact boundaries, zero/exhausted capacity, and single refusal fee
obligations.evidence: tests/unit/test_dataclass_selection_independent_acceptance.py tests covering: test_budget_lower_than_selection (budget=6, selection=100 -> used_work=2, INPUT_LIMIT), test_selection_lower_than_budget (selection=6, budget=100 -> used_work=2, INPUT_LIMIT), test_prior_cumulative_work_reduces_dataclass_capacity (prior=14, limit=20 -> used_work=16, INPUT_LIMIT), test_pending_siblings_congestion (pending=4 siblings, count=6, remaining=8 -> len(pending)+count=10 > 8 -> used_work=3, INPUT_LIMIT), test_exact_boundaries (budget=7, selection=7 -> used_work=7 SUCCESS; budget=6 -> used_work=2 FAIL; selection=6 -> used_work=2 FAIL), test_zero_and_exhausted_capacity (work_limit=0 -> used_work=1; work_limit=1 -> used_work=2), test_single_refusal_fee_no_double_charging (used_work=2). All 8 permutation scenarios pass.

obligations.title: fields() reflection allocations and custom attribute callback behavior
obligations.evidence: Verified reflection error containment (test_fields_reflection_exception_containment: trapped with code INPUT_LIMIT, used_work=2), arbitrary attribute getter exception containment (test_attribute_callback_arbitrary_exception_containment: trapped with code INPUT_LIMIT, used_work=2), and direct AdmissionRefused passthrough (test_attribute_callback_admission_refused_passthrough: re-raised with code INPUT_LIMIT, used_work=1 without double charging). Verified distinction between exception containment and bounded arbitrary callback execution: test_bounded_callback_execution_distinction proved arbitrary BombDataclass getters are NEVER executed when count > remaining capacity.
